meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels、注册到渠道入口并安装固定版本依赖，然后执行构建与测试；还会引导你填写 Resend 密钥、发件地址等，并把你的邮箱设为所有者、用你的地址发一封欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道、配置邮箱收发，或让 NanoClaw 支持邮件对话时使用。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱渠道。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建测试。

say.text: 用 Resend 配置邮件收发，然后给我的邮箱发封欢迎邮件。
say.note: 会引导填写密钥并把你的地址设为所有者。

say.text: 把 Resend 渠道注册到 NanoClaw，并验证邮件能收到。
say.note: 会执行注册、测试并检查配置。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude copies the Resend adapter into src/channels, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned dependency, then builds and tests. It also prompts for Resend credentials, wires your email as owner, and sends a hello email from your address.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add the Resend email channel, set up email send/receive, or enable email conversations in NanoClaw via the Chat SDK.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw for me.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, and runs build tests.

say_en.text: Set up Resend email send/receive, then send a hello email to my address.
say_en.note: Prompts for secrets and wires your address as owner.

say_en.text: Register the Resend channel in NanoClaw and verify email arrives.
say_en.note: Runs registration, tests, and checks configuration.
